recipes.t: Spinach and feta scramble on sourdough

steps.t: Whisk the eggs and egg whites with a pinch of salt.

Top with the sliced banana and the peanut butter.

Blend everything with a handful of ice until smooth.

Add the garlic and ginger (1 min), then the shredded cabbage and carrot and cook until just soft (4 min).
Toss with the soy sauce and top with green onion and sriracha.
Dice the chicken small and stir-fry until cooked (5 min).
Add the garlic (1 min), then the soy sauce and teriyaki (1 min).
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with shredded carrot, green onion and chopped peanuts.
Slice the tempeh and brown it in the sesame oil (6 min).
Add the teriyaki and let it glaze (1 min).
Steam the broccoli (4 min).
Serve over rice with the green onion.
Simmer the broth with the ginger and soy sauce.
Poach the sliced chicken and mushrooms in it until cooked (8 min); add the bok choy (2 min).
Soft-boil the egg (7 min) and halve it.
Pour over the cooked soba and top with the egg and green onion.
Cube the tofu and brown it in the sesame oil (8 min); set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper with a splash of water (4 min), add the garlic and ginger (1 min).
Return the tofu with the soy sauce and cashews.
Serve with the rice.
Pulse the cauliflower into rice-sized bits.
Stir-fry the diced chicken in the sesame oil until cooked (5 min); push aside and scramble the egg (1 min).
Add the cauliflower, peas and carrot and cook until tender (5 min).
Toss with the soy sauce and green onion.
Cut the chicken into strips and cook in the oil until browned and cooked (7 min).
Add the green beans and a splash of water, cover and steam (4 min).
Add the garlic (1 min) and soy sauce and toss.
Serve with the rice.
Toss the cubed chicken with half the yogurt, the paprika and salt.
Brown it in a hot pan with a splash of oil (6 min) and set aside.
Soften the onion (5 min), add the garlic, ginger and curry powder (1 min), then the tomatoes and simmer (10 min).
Return the chicken and simmer until cooked (5 min); stir in the rest of the yogurt off the heat.
Serve with the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil (5 min), add the garlic, ginger, cumin and curry powder (1 min).
Add the tomatoes, the lentils and a cup of water and simmer until thick (15 min).
Stir in the spinach.
Serve with the rice.
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Coat the chicken in the yogurt, curry powder, paprika, lemon and salt.
Toss the cauliflower florets with the oil and a pinch of salt.
Roast both on a sheet pan until the chicken is 165 F inside (25 min).
Serve with the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil (5 min), add the garlic, ginger and curry powder (1 min).
Add the tomatoes and peas and simmer (8 min).
Add the halved eggs and warm them through (3 min).
Serve with the rice.

recipes.t: Baked salmon, broccoli and brown rice

steps.t: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Rub the salmon with the oil, garlic and salt and bake until it flakes (12 min).
Steam the broccoli (4 min).
Serve with the rice and the lemon.
Mix the corn, diced tomato, onion and lime for the salsa.
Rub the fish with the paprika, chili powder and salt.
Sear in the hot oil until it flakes (3 min a side).
Serve over the rice with the salsa.

recipes.t: Garlic butter scallops with asparagus and wild rice

steps.t: Pat the scallops very dry and season them.
Sear in half the butter in a very hot pan, without moving them, until golden (2 min a side).
Cook the asparagus in the rest of the butter with the garlic (4 min).
Finish with the lemon and serve with the wild rice.

recipes.t: Salmon cakes with slaw and sweet potato

steps.t: Mix the salmon, breadcrumbs, egg, green onion and lemon; shape two patties.
Cook in a nonstick pan with a splash of oil until golden (4 min a side).
Toss the cabbage with the yogurt and a pinch of salt.
Serve with the baked sweet potato.
Cook the pasta with the peas for the last 2 minutes, then rinse cold.
Mix the yogurt, mayo, lemon and a pinch of salt.
Toss with the tuna, pasta, peas and diced celery.
Season the shrimp and sear until pink (3 min).
Dice the mango, avocado and cucumber.
Build the bowl over the quinoa and finish with the lime and cilantro.
Toast the bread and spread the avocado.
Top with the sardines, arugula and lemon.

recipes.t: Lemon herb cod with potatoes and green beans

steps.t: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Roast the halved potatoes with half the oil (15 min).
Add the cod and green beans, brush with the rest of the oil, garlic and lemon.
Roast until the cod flakes (12 min).
Mash the beans, leaving some whole, and mix with the breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion, cumin and salt.
Shape patties and chill (10 min).
Cook in a nonstick pan with a splash of oil until crisp (4 min a side).
Serve on the buns with lettuce, tomato and avocado.

recipes.t: Stuffed sweet potato with black beans

steps.t: Prick the sweet potato and microwave until soft (8 min).
Warm the beans and corn.
Split the potato and fill with the beans, corn, salsa and avocado.
Finish with the lime and cilantro.
Mash the chickpeas with the tahini, lemon, mustard and salt.
Fold in the diced celery and pickle.
Spread on the bread with the lettuce.
Cook the sliced mushrooms until browned (5 min) and wilt the spinach in the same pan.
Fill half the tortilla with the vegetables, beans and cheese and fold.
Toast until crisp and melted (3 min a side).
Salsa on the side.
Heat the oven to 400 F.
Soften the onion and carrot in the oil (6 min), add the tomatoes, broth, lentils and peas and simmer until thick (10 min).
Mash the cooked potatoes with the soy milk and salt.
Spread the lentils in a dish, top with the mash and bake until golden (20 min).
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Toss the cubed squash and the chickpeas with the oil and salt and roast (25 min).
Massage the kale with the lemon.
Build the bowl over the quinoa and drizzle the tahini thinned with water.
Grill or pan-sear the mushroom caps until tender (4 min a side), cheese on for the last minute.
Toast the bun and build the burger with arugula and tomato.
Steamed edamame on the side (3 min).
Soften the onion, pepper and garlic with a splash of oil (6 min).
Stir in the chili powder and cumin (1 min).
Add the tomatoes and all the beans and simmer (25 min).
Spread the hummus on the tortilla.
Layer the turkey and the thinly sliced vegetables.
Roll it tight.
Toss the quinoa and arugula with the oil and balsamic.
Top with the chicken, tomatoes and feta.
Spread the mustard on the bread.
Layer the ham, swiss, thin apple slices and lettuce.
Top the cottage cheese with the diced cucumber and tomato.
Finish with the oil, black pepper and a pinch of salt; rice cakes on the side.
Chop the chicken and mix with the yogurt, diced celery, halved grapes, walnuts and salt.
Spread on the bread with the lettuce.
Pack the eggs, edamame, rice cakes, grapes and carrot sticks in a box.
Mash half the avocado with the lime and salt and fold in the tuna.
Toss with the diced cucumber, tomato and onion and the rest of the avocado.
Serve over the greens.
Pack the turkey, cheese, crackers, apple and carrot sticks.

recipes.t: Cuban-style pork with black beans and rice

steps.t: Rub the pork with the garlic, cumin, oregano, half the lime and salt.
Sear on all sides and roast at 425 F to 145 F inside (18 min), then rest (5 min).
Warm the beans with the onion.
Slice the pork and serve with the rice, beans and the rest of the lime.
Cook the seasoned beef patty to 160 F inside (4 min a side) and slice it.
Chop the lettuce, tomato, pickle and onion.
Top with the burger, cheese, avocado and mustard.
Cook the diced chicken in a nonstick pan until cooked (6 min).
Add the zucchini (3 min), the quinoa and tomatoes (2 min).
Stir in the pesto off the heat.
Sear the salmon in the sesame oil, skin side down, until almost cooked (5 min), flip (2 min).
Add the teriyaki and spoon it over the fish (1 min).
Stir-fry the snap peas in the same pan (3 min).
Serve with the rice and green onion.

recipes.t: Chicken and white bean soup with kale

steps.t: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic with a splash of oil (6 min).
Add the broth and the chicken and simmer until cooked (15 min); shred the chicken.
Add the beans and kale and simmer until the kale is tender (5 min).
Rub the steak with the chili powder and salt, sear in a very hot pan (4 min a side) and rest (5 min).
Char the sliced pepper and onion in the same pan (6 min).
Slice the steak thin.
Build the bowl with rice, vegetables, steak, salsa, avocado and lime.
Soften the pepper and mushrooms in the butter (4 min) and add the spinach.
Pour in the whisked eggs, cook without stirring until set (4 min).
Add the cheese, fold, and serve with the sliced avocado.

recipes.t: Eggs, turkey bacon and berries plate

steps.t: Crisp the turkey bacon (4 min).
Fry or scramble the eggs in the same pan (3 min).
Plate with the raspberries and avocado.
Wilt the spinach in the oil (1 min).
Add the whisked eggs and stir slowly (2 min), then fold in the flaked salmon until hot (1 min).
Top with the sour cream and green onion.

recipes.t: Cottage cheese with walnuts and cinnamon

steps.t: Top the cottage cheese with the walnuts, raspberries and a dusting of cinnamon.

recipes.t: Peanut butter banana toast with soy milk

steps.t: Toast the bread and spread the peanut butter.
Top with the sliced banana; a glass of soy milk on the side.
Stir the oats, soy milk, chia and maple syrup together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with the blueberries.
Crisp the diced cooked potatoes in the oil over medium-high heat (8 min).
Add the onion and pepper (4 min).
Crumble in the tofu with the paprika and salt and cook until golden at the edges (6 min).
Sear the seasoned steak in a hot pan (4 min a side) and rest it (5 min).
Melt the butter with the garlic in the same pan (1 min) and toss the broccoli in it until hot (3 min).
Slice the steak and spoon the garlic butter over it.
Heat the oven to 425 F.
Lay the salmon and asparagus on a pan, brush with the oil, garlic and half the lemon.
Roast until the salmon flakes (12 min).
Finish with the rest of the lemon.

recipes.t: Crispy chicken thighs with green beans

steps.t: Rub the chicken with the paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Sear in the oil in an oven-safe pan (5 min), then roast at 425 F until 165 F inside (15 min).
Toss the green beans in the pan juices for the last 5 minutes (5 min).
Steam the cauliflower until very soft (10 min) and mash it with the butter, milk and salt.
Season the cod and cook it in a nonstick pan until it flakes (4 min a side).
Wilt the spinach in the same pan (1 min).
Spiralize or thinly slice the zucchini.
Warm the oil with the sliced garlic (1 min), add the shrimp and cook until pink (3 min).
Toss in the zucchini just until hot (2 min).
Finish with the lemon and parmesan.

recipes.t: Pork chops with roasted Brussels sprouts

steps.t: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Toss the halved sprouts with the oil and salt and roast (15 min).
Sear the seasoned chops (3 min a side), brush with the mustard and roast with the sprouts to 145 F inside (8 min).
Heat the oven to 375 F.
Brown the turkey with the onion and cumin (6 min) and stir in the tomatoes.
Fill the halved peppers, top with the cheese and bake until the peppers are tender (25 min).

recipes.t: Chicken Caesar lettuce bowl, no croutons

steps.t: Whisk the yogurt, oil, lemon, mustard, grated garlic and half the parmesan.
Toss the romaine in the dressing.
Top with the sliced chicken and the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.t: Sesame tofu and vegetable stir-fry, no rice

steps.t: Cube the tofu and brown it in the sesame oil (8 min).
Add the vegetables with a splash of water and stir-fry until crisp-tender (4 min).
Add the garlic and ginger (1 min) and the soy sauce.
Chop the eggs and mix with the mayo, yogurt, mustard, diced celery and salt.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves.
